card.name: Linking words before tumor findings
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "and" right before a tumor or cancer term in animal carcinogenicity text, e.g. "increased incidence of" followed by a tumor type. Also fires on letter-spaced text fragments.

modes.label: Incidence of tumors
modes.description: The word "of" after increased incidence(s) in rodent carcinogenicity findings.
modes.example: There was, however, an increased incidence<< of>> benign stromal uterine pol

modes.label: And between tumor types
modes.description: "and" or "cell" inside a list of tumors in rat or mouse studies.
modes.example: Lymphomas<< and>> lung cancers were observed at a higher rate

modes.label: Letter-spaced words
modes.description: A single letter inside a word spaced out letter by letter in a table or heading.
modes.example: S e ro t o n e r g i<< c>> Drugs : Concomitant use may result
